The *Sabbasattahitapharaṇapañha* ("When Teaching is Harmful", Mil 5.3.2) is a section of the *Milindapañha* preserved in the Pali tradition. The inquiry addresses doctrinal questions surrounding the effects of the Dhamma's delivery, drawing a connection to the *Aggikkhandhopamasutta* of the *Aṅguttara Nikāya* (AN 7.72).
